title: Read two function templates
description: You can follow type parameters through a comparison and a predicate-based count.

steps.description: max_of accepts two values of type T. It returns a when a > b and otherwise returns b.
count_if_manual takes a container and predicate. It uses the container's size_type for its counter and increments for each accepted element.
The three max_of calls supply integers, doubles, and strings. The recorded results are 7, 3.14, and xyz.

steps.question: How many elements satisfy the supplied even-number predicate?

steps.description: The lambda supplies the predicate to count_if_manual. The final output reads evens: 3.
